Slop 365 · business apps

Slop 365: business apps that run in your browser

Invoices, orders, contacts, inventory, CRM, ledger, reports, tables, docs and notes. Each one is a separate app with its own page.

The tools

  • Slop Invoices
    In development
    Gapless invoices, payments and a ledger. Nothing uploaded.
  • Slop Orders
    In development
    Customers, products and orders. Nothing uploaded.
  • Slop Contacts
    In development
    Address book: vCard and CSV in and out, duplicates merged.
  • Slop Inventory
    In development
    Products, stock and barcode scanning. Nothing uploaded.
  • Slop CRM
    In development
    Customers, a pipeline board and follow-ups. Nothing uploaded.
  • Slop Ledger
    In development
    Double-entry books, trial balance and exchange rates.
  • Slop Reports
    Beta
    Totals and lists across Contacts, Invoices and CRM. Read-only.
  • Slop Tables
    In development
    Excel and Google Sheets, rebuilt for the browser.
  • Slop Docs
    In development
    Word and Google Docs, rebuilt for the browser.
  • Slop Notes
    In development
    Notebooks and Markdown notes, saved to Slop Drive.
